clientProof.psqlAuthority: Same persistent pinned psql/libpq process used for the operation; fixed conninfo metadata plus locked effective verify-full parameters, CA identity, service identity and runtime image. A separate diagnostic connection is not authority for the operation session.
clientProof.certificateSubjectSANFingerprint: Optional only if the reviewed actual client metadata mechanism supplies it; never fabricate it from backend SQL.
clientProof.poolerIdentity: Bind official session endpoint host hash, port 5432, project suffix identity, database postgres, authenticated database role, pinned CA and versioned contract. A shared endpoint certificate alone does not uniquely identify the tenant.
clientProof.parser: Pinned tool version, fixed locale, strict finite parser; unexpected output fails TLS_METADATA_UNAVAILABLE. No password/DSN/raw connection output in public receipts.
clientProof.timing: Validate on every new production session before ledger/catalog or mutation; capture retains RR READ ONLY, one snapshot, ROLLBACK. No downgrade/retry/fallback.
clientProof.dumpLimitation: Current pg_dump/pg_dumpall do not expose the same psql metadata path. A per-tool enforcement attestation can bind exact pinned libpq tool, effective verify-full service/CA hashes and success, but this must be explicitly reviewed as enforced-connection proof, not represented as observed protocol/cipher. If observed per-connection metadata is required, a separately scoped mechanism remains unresolved.

trustBoundaries.between: Operator host and provider database endpoint
trustBoundaries.operator: Pin officially obtained direct hostname, port, database, user, CA and approved network route; verify-full plus same-session client metadata.
trustBoundaries.provider: Present the appropriate certificate and authenticate the database role.

trustBoundaries.between: Provider endpoint identity and project database isolation
trustBoundaries.provider: Bind the direct endpoint to the project and protect database infrastructure.
trustBoundaries.operator: Require non-secret project endpoint provenance and database/role identity. Do not call a pooled alias direct.

requiredGates: Client metadata confirms TLS and locked verify-full invocation verifies hostname/CA.
pg_stat_ssl for the same direct session is true.
No proxy fallback, transaction-pooler fallback or CLI/environment endpoint override.

network.limitation: No IPv6 default route is a local prerequisite gap, not proof that every possible direct route is unavailable.

credentialContract.officialModel: Direct and shared-pooler examples use a database password but different usernames. Existing password validity for a direct login was not inspected or tested.
credentialContract.configurationChanges: A separately approved private service/passfile mapping and credential identity would be necessary for a different endpoint/user; no secret copying or generation now.
credentialContract.currentGuardDependency: _validate_credentials assumes postgres.<project>; direct postgres requires a reviewed alternative project-binding mechanism, not deleting identity checks.

evidenceNeeded: Official project-specific direct hostname/port from a trusted existing export or provider Connect configuration; never synthesize DNS from project ref.
Applicable direct CA identity and SSL policy.
Usable IPv6 route or verified IPv4 add-on endpoint; no network changes authorized.
Database credential applicability, connection budget/timeouts and maintenance suitability.
captureApplyBackup: One approved direct maintenance profile for all operations; application transport is independent.
